source_basis: Current local website/public files and website/app content; no remote deployment comparison.

data_validation.note: Includes all 21 data/phenotype-survival outcome asset_path references, extending the initial public-verification.json check.

limitations: This is a local-source snapshot, not a crawl or verification of a remote deployment.
Runtime study data and figures live in the sibling data and images folders supplied by the transfer package.
Dynamic content is not evaluated; numbers, feature names, categories, counts, and study-specific caveats are supplied by the copied study JSON data.
Conditional display text is included even when not visible in the initial page view.
Whitespace and HTML entities are normalized for reuse. Chart hover markup is converted to plain text, preserving text order.
{{value_1}} and {{chart_value_1}} are content-template placeholders; source line metadata identifies the original occurrence.
No executable source, imports, CSS classes, event handlers, credentials, raw patient records, or notebook contents are copied.

independent_audit: A separate read-only audit confirmed exact public-file coverage, manifest/index joins, nested column alignment, and all 168 phenotype panels.
